text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well then. Guess it's about time to 
head home.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to take a detour?
Aren't you going to take a detour?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Jordan! We're about to hang out, wanna 
come with?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, hold on a sec.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...Nah, I'll pass for now. See ya."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Not really. Just ain't in the mood—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's with that poster?! 'New 
Burger Now on Sale'?! I gotta eat that—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: N-No no no... Forget it, it's nothing.
(Grrr~~)

Tosen Jordan is acting strange... For now, 
we decided to head into a burger joint to 
grab a bite to eat.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Umm... the new burger... Ah, this one... 
The nutritional values are...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, seriously!? It's over 800, that's 
crazy bad...!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I think I'll go with salad. After 
all, nowadays it's all about... uh, 
vegetable-heavy, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for the grub. Welp, guess I'll 
head home—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, isn't that something rolling right 
towards me that's practically begging to 
be kicked?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wanna play soccer? Sepak takraw? Or how 
about đá cầu~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Guuugh, that pisses me off! Spouting 
gibberish again...! But—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! It's nothing. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...What's up with that guy? Did aliens 
swap out his brain or something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, this time I'm really going 
home. I'm totally going home, resting... 
and resting...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Restaurant Server
text_block_list.text:
Our super popular Japanese set is now on 
sale~!

text_block_list.name: Cosmetics Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The cosmetics featured in the magazine now 
have new shades on sale~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ~~gh... No way!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna eat Japanese food! I wanna look at 
cosmetics too! I wanna have even more 
fun!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I did my best today! I endured so, so 
much!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Because, I mean, that's totally uncool!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Back then, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even the part where I said let's go home 
'cause I'm tired—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The reason you suggested rescheduling the 
inn was also—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Schedule management, huh? It's for my 
sake, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Having you do everything for me while I 
can't do a damn thing myself... That's way 
too lame!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still... no way. It's exhausting. It's too 
brutal. There's no way I can do this.
choice_data_list:
When that happens, I want you to lean on 
me like this

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Wh-What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean... are you seriously saying that? 
Sounds like a total pain, doing all 
that... I'm already totally wiped, y'know?
choice_data_list: That's what being a Trainer is about.
That's what being a Trainer is about.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...You sure you wanna say that? 'Cause I 
might ask for something seriously crazy, 
y'know.
choice_data_list: No one gets it right at first.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's with that?! So passionate! 
Are you some kind of hot-blooded anime 
hero?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then... bring it on. I'll master that 
micromanaging style of yours, just you 
watch.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, jumping right into it~~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Potatoes are vegetables, so they have zero 
calories, right?

...It seems the road will be long, but I 
resolved to keep cheering for her until 
she stands on her own.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, where did all that enthusiasm from 
earlier go?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah~~~?! What gives?! You startled 
me, stop messing around~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"If that's how it is, fine. I'm gonna make 
this super, thoroughly annoying for you!"

Her unyielding spirit is her greatest 
weapon. As long as she has this 
determination, she will surely achieve her 
goals...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, is that from personal experience?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Let's hear it. Sounds kinda 
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about your #1 biggest failure! I 
kinda wanna hear about a big screw-up!

On the way back to the academy. I shared 
some stories from my time in training.

By opening up about myself, I felt like I 
had grown a little closer to Tosen 
Jordan...
